en.title: FOB vs CIF Quote Check for Chinese Vehicles Shipped to the Middle East
en.seo_title: FOB vs CIF Quote Check for the Middle East: Saudi, Qatar and UAE Gates
en.meta_description: Separate FOB and CIF shipping obligations from Gulf conformity and national import controls: Qatar customs-value mechanics, Saudi ZATCA age and prohibition rules, and the UAE MoIAT consultation-stage used-vehicle categories whose current binding instrument must be confirmed.
en.summary: One quote hides three questions: what the Incoterm moves, whether the state admits the vehicle, and the landed total. Qatar and Saudi rules are documented; the UAE seven-category description rests on a 2023 MoIAT consultation and its current binding instrument and 2026 applicability are not re-verified.
en.method: Document research and procurement analysis of Incoterms materials and official Qatar, Saudi and UAE sources; WTO/GSO materials are framework or pointers. Rules are national and not interchangeable.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand shipment, customs clearance, transaction or ownership is claimed. The UAE seven-category description comes from a 2023 MoIAT consultation page; its current binding instrument and 2026 applicability are not re-verified. Detailed GCC conformity mechanics, other Middle Eastern states' rules and live freight/testing/insurance costs are not asserted.

zh.title: 中国车辆出口中东的 FOB 与 CIF 报价核对（沙特、卡塔尔、阿联酋）
zh.seo_title: 中东 FOB/CIF 报价核对：沙特、卡塔尔与阿联酋关口
zh.meta_description: 把 FOB/CIF 运输义务与海湾合格性、国家进口管控分开：卡塔尔完税价格机制、沙特 ZATCA 车龄与禁止规则，以及阿联酋 MoIAT 处于征询阶段、现行约束性文件仍须确认的二手车类别。
zh.summary: 一份报价藏着三个问题：术语转移了什么、国家是否准入、落地总额多少。卡塔尔与沙特规则有据；阿联酋七类描述来自 2023 年 MoIAT 征询，其现行约束性文件与 2026 适用性未重新核实。
zh.method: 针对 Incoterms 材料与卡塔尔、沙特、阿联酋官方来源做文献研究与采购分析，WTO/GSO 作框架或指引；各国规则各自国别、不可互换。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手发运、清关、交易或持有经历。阿联酋七类描述来自 2023 年 MoIAT 征询页，现行约束性文件与 2026 适用性未重新核实；GCC 合格性具体机制、其他中东国家规则与实时运费/检测/保险成本均不主张。
